body:
Deal: Aberlour A'Bunadh Single Malt Scotch Whisky 700ml $117 (Member's Price) + Del ($0 C&C/ to Metro with $149 Order) @ Dan Murphy's

[unit0000] Great post. Hasn't been this low in a very long time. Right up there for the price.
[Gusper] Never bought this since the bottle changed. Still haven’t tasted the bottles i bought 12 months ago
[kaboom mel] Is the WINTER25 code targeted ? I get a message saying I am not eligible for the promotion
[RoryLyons] I'm not eligible for that code unfortunately
[Poimandres] My Dan Murphy's tip is to look for whatever product you are seeking with price sorted high to low. There are store specific deals not listed as clearance that will show up in the list where the initial price would be.
For example, tonight I grabbed a bottle of Lark Kurio listed for $61 from a nearby store ($55 after the code was applied).
Sorted price high to low it was sandwiched between a $125 and $120 bottle (the regular price being $122). I don't think there is a handy tool like the BWS Clearance site but correct me if I'm wrong. Anyway, with a little digging you can find these sorts of deals but they are store specific. Common enough to find 50% off bottles using this method.
[muwu] Thanks.
Gave it a few goes. Nothing came up 😔
[UncleanLibertine] One of the greatest whiskies ever. Totally converted me to cask strength drops
[Aweedram] I drink this straight. It’s around 60% alcohol and still rather smooth. Outstanding whisky.
